name: Blatella
source:
“Feelings are unnecessary when there is work to be done.”

Blatella seeks the truth—or at least the most compelling version of it. Tired of bland village life, he began spicing up his reports with bold interpretations. Now disliked by many, he doesn’t care, as long as the job gets done.
